title: Cosmic Bear Collage
description: A surreal psychedelic collage featuring a large brown bear head with glowing eyes, a cosmic galaxy bear in the center, and a green corn cob character wearing a military helmet and smoking at the top. Below are a vibrant swirling portal over a futuristic city, a cosmic dripping donut on a wooden platform, a green bird on a floating rock, and a powerful waterfall landscape on the right.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic collage with a giant brown teddy bear head with glowing starry eyes in the upper left, a green corn cob soldier wearing a metal helmet with smoke coming out in the upper center, a large cosmic galaxy bear with stars and nebulae as its fur in the middle, a swirling colorful pink and orange portal revealing a futuristic city at sunset, a large cosmic donut with colorful stars dripping glaze on a wooden platform, a small green bird perched on a floating rock, and a majestic waterfall cascading through a forested rocky landscape on the right side.
